name: Flocksy
summary: A dedicated creative team for one flat monthly fee. Unlimited graphic design, video editing, motion graphics and web design — your marketing never waits on a freelancer again.
best_for: marketing teams and agencies with steady, recurring creative volume (ads, social, video edits) that want predictable flat-fee capacity instead of freelancer wrangling
skip_if: your design needs are occasional or spiky (pay per project instead), or you need one senior specialist deeply embedded in your brand
honest_knock: 'Unlimited' means unlimited queue, not unlimited throughput: work happens at your plan's daily capacity, so a big launch week still needs planning, and turnaround expectations are where subscription-design relationships sour. The economics are simple and honest — against even one freelance designer's day rate, the math works IF you feed it steady volume; if your design needs are sporadic, a flat monthly fee is paying for silence — unused hours do bank, but only for 30 days.

pricing.entry_price_terms: 2 hours a day · per month billed annually
pricing.notes: Flat monthly plans priced by dedicated creative hours per business day: $1,199/mo for 2h/day, $1,699 (3h/day), $2,199 (4h/day), $2,599 (5h/day), $2,999 (6h/day), $3,399 (7h/day) and $3,799/mo for 8h/day, each billed annually and shown per month (re-verified 2026-09-23; every annual and monthly rate unchanged since 3 September and the annual ones since 6 August; the monthly ladder runs $1,699 to $5,899 a month, and the quarterly toggle is marked "Save 17%+" against "Save 29%+" for annual). Plans start at 2 daily hours and scale to 8, with custom teams beyond that; month-to-month costs more — on the 4h/day plan Flocksy prices annual billing as saving $10,800/yr versus monthly. The pricing page carries a 14-day money-back guarantee, says plan switches take effect on the next billing cycle, and lists every plan as "No contracts" and "Cancel anytime" beside the annual billing.
